 'iPhone 20 Pro' Rumored to Be Based on iPhone Air
 Monday November 16, 2026 5:40 am PST by Hartley Charlton Next year's "iPhone 20 Pro" models will use the same glass design as the iPhone Air , but with more pronounced curvature along all four sides, according to the leaker known as " Fixed Focus Digital ."
In a new post on Weibo, the leaker said the device would use the same glass material as the ‌iPhone Air‌, adjusted to have greater curvature and produce a four-sided curved effect. The accompanying hashtag refers specifically to an "iPhone 20 Pro" with a four-sided curved, "all-glass" design.
 An illustration shared with the post depicts rounded front and rear glass meeting a narrow, polished, gold-colored metallic frame. Physical side buttons, antenna lines, and a protruding rear camera assembly remain visible. 
 Taken together with earlier rumors and the post's accompanying illustration, the repeated comparisons suggest a design somewhere between the iPhone X and ‌iPhone Air‌. The ‌iPhone Air‌ provides a reference for the slim profile and a more modern iPhone design, while the more pronounced glass curvature recalls the rounded edges of the iPhone X. Both feature a polished frame.
 The latest claim builds on Fixed Focus Digital's previous report that Apple had modified ‌iPhone Air‌ manufacturing equipment to produce more rounded glass components for the 20th anniversary models. The leaker said the changes had helped reduce manufacturing costs, while substantially improving thinness and heat dissipation.
 In a still-earlier report , the same leaker also claimed that a supply chain facility had completed renovations ahead of "iPhone 20" production, with manufacturing quality expected to be roughly comparable to the first-generation ‌iPhone Air‌. The ‌iPhone Air‌ features Ceramic Shield 2 on the front and Ceramic Shield on the back. 
 The broader design picture aligns with Bloomberg 's Mark Gurman 's reporting that Apple's anniversary Pro models will feature glass that curves into the sides from both the front and rear, with a thin metal band between the two panels. Gurman has also described thinner display bezels and curved glass around all corners and edges, in what he expects to be the biggest overhaul of the Pro line since the iPhone X. 
 Apple's 20th-anniversary iPhone models are expected to launch in the fall of 2027 . While leakers have variably referred to the device as the "iPhone 20 Pro," Apple's naming plans remain unclear. It seems plausible that the company could skip the iPhone 19 name to emphasize the anniversary, similar to its introduction of the iPhone X in 2017.

 B Biro 4 days ago at 05:52 am It looks like those who believe the iPhone Air is a proof-of-concept model for future iPhones have a point. Score: 8 Votes ( Like | Disagree ) thadoggfather 4 days ago at 07:17 am mockup I've seen on X.
seems like a logical move, I always thought iPhone Air (and now Duo) are more premium than the Pros.
Titanium would be nice to bring back, its less thermally sound but way more structurally robust against drops and scrapes and looks a lot more elegant. SS polish on 13 pro and 14 pro looks other worldly still, but way too heavy. The matte Titanium on 15 and 16 pro was a bit of a regression, and now I think aluminum even more so -- even though lighter. 
Not sure about the front rounded glass rumor, since they aren't going with edge but some sort of optical distortion to appear like its dropping off the edge. Sounds somewhat gimmicky.
Also pretty excited for Air 2 to come out in the spring, even though I returned my Air early on (Battery life, single camera, bad speaker) it felt like the future direction of IPhone in its fresh form factor vs. more of the same old for so long. and of course Duo pushes the envelope even further with their future vision.
 Score: 6 Votes ( Like | Disagree ) Z zubikov 4 days ago at 05:59 am What's the point of making a state of the art, sleek, slim, fast, beautiful smartphone...when there's a massive, asymmetric, uneven, fugly camera bump permanently attached to it? I don't care if iPhone XX's body is as thin as a potato chip. As long as that camera bump is there, it's bad design. Score: 5 Votes ( Like | Disagree ) B bluecoast 4 days ago at 06:11 am Yes to rounded sides again, but not slippery ones please as Apple has sometimes done previously.
And yes to ‘iPhone 20’ and not ‘iPhone XX’…
…Because that means the iPhone 30 will then have to be the ‘iPhone XXX’. Ulp. Score: 4 Votes ( Like | Disagree ) switz 4 days ago at 06:05 am All those who think that they can afford Apple's prices today may be challenged next year as they ratchet upwards significantly. Apple would not be the first business to price itself out of existence.:oops::cool:
Laptops just went up around $500 for touch screen that no one asked for with the implied promise those touch screen models will be the only choice going forward next year.😟
The Neo is cute, but not a real work machine. The MacBook Air is intentionally crippled with less max memory than the chip would support and a limited range of SSD size to 2TB. So those that need more power will give a second quart of blood for the new device.....
They just released new doodads (see the shinny new thing) while the guts of the machines (the operating systems) languish in purgatory in terms of actually being debugged. 
But bugs in the software has been a chronic issue since 1990 from my experience. And some issues just floated along to succeeding versions like a leaf floating down the creek. :eek::oops: Score: 4 Votes ( Like | Disagree ) Gasu E. 4 days ago at 05:52 am 
So, it will be an iPhone Air but with the features of the normal iPhone, right?
